svg.text: 費用対効果と回収期間

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif
Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: 年間効果 = 削減時間/日 × 稼働日 × 時間単価

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: annual value = time saved per day × working days × hourly rate

text.font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', Meiryo, sans-serif

svg.text: 回収期間 = 投資 ÷ (年間効果 − 年間運用費) payback = investment / (annual benefit − annual operating cost)
